laminate_registration.z_stack_policy: Kept identical to the current model per user direction; the physical laminate thickness and assembled compression were not independently measured or tested.

resource_windows.source: Six orange marked regions, mapped with a single paper-centered transform

cube_grid.policy: Retain six separate cube tracks, openings and webs. Convert the user-measured lower/upper row offsets from the laminated outer edge into model coordinates using the measured 227 x 168 mm insert and centered 238.401 x 179 mm frame. Translate each printed row independently and balance residuals over every cell in that row. Preserve the 9.16 mm opening pitch and 8.64 mm openings, so 8.5 mm printed cells cannot all be centered without overlap.

physical_fit: The 3.0 mm sockets / 2.6 mm pins are inherited from the previously coupon-tested variant. The new 2.5 mm front, shortened pins, laminate-edge registration, resized windows and complete tableau fit have not been physically tested. The user asked to preserve the existing Z stack; laminate thickness/compression remains unverified.
